evals.prompt: Build a high-fantasy waterworks courtyard with visible crystal source, conduit and pump receiver, active/inactive variants. Use an isolated project, preserve supplied references and produce scoped assets with honest evidence. If Blender or image inspection is unavailable, provide the specification and mark affected checks unexecuted.
evals.expected_output: An editable subject-specific kit or explicitly unexecuted production specification, requested dimensions/states, named diagnostics, actual findings and separate technical/visual/engine evidence status.
assertions: Eye view, roofless structure plan, seam sheet and magic-off comparison. Inspect stairs/doors with human proxy and landmark hierarchy in grayscale.
Supplied camera, scale and fiction remain authoritative; concrete pieces and state variants are identified.
Image acceptance cites actually inspected current-revision images and observations, not file existence.
No game behavior, AI, balance, physics or engine performance is inferred from renders or static proxies.

evals.prompt: Repair a dark entrance hidden by fog and unsupported floating masonry while retaining approved mood and user fiction. Inspect before editing; preserve original source and work only in authorized asset collections. Repeat affected diagnostics after repair.
evals.expected_output: A bounded diagnosis and targeted repair retaining approved source/style, with matched subject-specific before/after evidence or an explicit blocked/unverified result.
assertions: Featureless dark palette: restore broad value groups and directional light. Generic crystal clutter: reduce sources and reveal their service chain. Unexplained floating masonry: provide authored magical support or repair structure. Anachronistic utility: explain or replace within scope.
Asset repairs are separated from game-rule and engine-system changes.
The original is preserved; affected checks and actual image review are repeated after editing.
A static numerical or geometry pass is not claimed as gameplay, historical authenticity or scientific proof.

evals.prompt: Build a low-magic roof corner and a publicly magical modern frontage with source, conduit, receiver and service access. Use an isolated authorized source; if execution or image inspection is unavailable, return the concrete specification and mark those checks unexecuted.
evals.expected_output: Subtype-specific construction/state and repair artifacts, or an explicit unexecuted specification, with actual diagnostic evidence distinguished from visual and engine acceptance.
assertions: Low-magic junction has actual support/finish/fastener logic from the chosen references.
Urban layer retains city utilities, mounting and ordinary/magical state separation.
Provides neutral, service and emission-off diagnostics rather than relying on generic crystals.

evals.prompt: A dark-fantasy bay has unsupported slabs, corruption everywhere and no visible human entrance. Repair without replacing the approved cosmology. Use an isolated authorized source; if execution or image inspection is unavailable, return the concrete specification and mark those checks unexecuted.
evals.expected_output: Subtype-specific construction/state and repair artifacts, or an explicit unexecuted specification, with actual diagnostic evidence distinguished from visual and engine acceptance.
assertions: Retains intact source and separates damage/corruption chronology.
Repairs support or makes authored supernatural support explicit and adds actual human-scale access.
Compares bright/atmospheric and corruption-off views without claiming structural safety.
